findings.message: 8 headline(s) switch typeface or to italic mid-line (the "one italic serif word" move).
findings.fix: Set the whole headline in one face. Emphasis comes from the words.

findings.message: 8 eyebrow/kicker label(s) above headings: "Từ 21 · 12 · 2025" above "10"; "Chương một" above "Chuyện của chúng mình"; "Chương hai" above "Những khung hình của em và anh"; "Đếm ngược" above "Chặng đường tới kỷ niệm 1 năm"; "Chương ba" above "Lá thư anh chưa nói hết"
findings.fix: Delete them. If the label carried real information, fold it into the headline or the supporting sentence.

findings.message: Decorative index numbers: "09"
findings.fix: Remove them. If order truly matters, write it into the words ("First, …") or use a real <ol>.

findings.message: 18 tiny uppercase letter-spaced labels (e.g. "21 · 12 · 2025", "Từ 21 · 12 · 2025", "Chương một", "21 · 12 · 2025").
findings.fix: Use sentence-case text at a readable size, or delete the label.

findings.message: Emoji in the page: ♥ ✦
findings.fix: Remove. Use words or real imagery.

findings.message: 25 gradient fill(s): div.sky → radial-gradient(1100px 800px at 50% 116%, rgba(255, 140, 180, 0.15), rgba(0, 0, 0, 0) 62%), radial-gradient(90 | div#gate.gate → radial-gradient(circle at 50% 40%, rgba(30, 22, 70, 0.94), rgba(4, 6, 14, 0.984)) | figure.photo.no-img → linear-gradient(135deg, rgb(36, 26, 77), rgb(58, 36, 84) 52%, rgb(28, 20, 54))
findings.fix: Use a flat colour or a real image. The only gradient allowed by default is a neutral scrim over a photo for legibility.

findings.message: 1 gradient-filled text element(s).
findings.fix: Solid colour text.

findings.message: 7 box-shadow(s) on elements at rest: div.tl-card → rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.28) 0px 22px 60px 0px | div.tl-card → rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.28) 0px 22px 60px 0px | div.tl-card → rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.28) 0px 22px 60px 0px
findings.fix: Remove. Separate surfaces with a tone step or space. Shadows are for things that really float (menus, dialogs, sticky bars).

findings.message: 10 text-shadow(s).
findings.fix: Remove; fix legibility with a scrim or a different crop.

findings.message: Buttons with gradient fill and shadow/glow.
findings.fix: Flat fill, one colour.

findings.message: 6 thin rule(s)/divider line(s): figure.photo.no-img 440px | figure.photo.no-img 440px | figure.photo.no-img 440px | figure.photo.no-img 440px
findings.fix: Delete. Separate with space, a tone change, or scale. Lines are only for real tables and form fields.

findings.message: 24 boxes drawn with a 1px outline.
findings.fix: Define a surface by its fill (one tone step from the page) or leave the content unboxed.

findings.message: 7 backdrop-blur surfaces.
findings.fix: One blurred sticky bar at most; glass cards are a tell.
A page needs about five: display, heading, lead, body, small.

findings.message: Body text is 15.5px.
findings.fix: Body copy 16–20px.

findings.message: Only 0 picture(s) on the page (0 photographs, footage or raster images, 0 interface fragments). Drawings in SVG do not count.
findings.fix: Find real pictures of the subject's world with scripts/assets.mjs (photographs, archival images, maps, engravings, footage), download them to assets/ and give them room: a hero picture, one per section that has a subject, a full-width band. At least four, usually six to twelve.

findings.message: No video anywhere on the page.
findings.fix: Look for one honest clip with scripts/assets.mjs --video (the place, the material, the process) and use it as a muted loop with a poster frame. Defend its absence only if no clip fits the subject.

findings.message: 28 text blocks under 13px.
findings.fix: Nothing meant to be read goes below 13px.

findings.message: A 452px stretch at 5328px holds nothing.
findings.fix: Check that it is a deliberate rest (once per page at most); otherwise close it to the normal section gap.

findings.message: 2 h1 elements.
findings.fix: One h1 per page; section titles are h2.

findings.message: 29% of the first screen is one empty block (480×780px at 0,120).
findings.fix: Place the void on purpose or fill it: move the picture, the film or one fact into it, grow the headline to meet it, or shrink the screen to its content. A void reads as placed only when something closes it on the far side and it is the screen's one rest.

findings.message: Large text lies under another element at some scroll position: "Quỳnh Anh" (screen 1, 100% hidden); "Anh" (screen 8, 100% hidden); "Chuyện của chúng mình" (screen 2, 100% hidden); "Ngày mình bắt đầu" (screen 2, 100% hidden)
findings.fix: Nothing may sit on top of a headline or statement. Move the picture, shorten the pinned run, or raise the text above it (z-index) and give it a ground.

findings.message: The same large text stays on screen for 9 screens in a row: "Gửi em, Quỳnh Anh"
findings.fix: A pinned element earns two screens, and something must change at each. Shorten the run or give every screen its own content.

findings.message: 1 headline(s) wrap past two lines at 390px: "10 tháng. Và còn rất nhiều tháng nữa." → 3 lines (8 words, 31px)
findings.fix:
Cut words first (a headline is a title, not a sentence). Then give it a wider measure. Lower the size only as a last resort and never below the scale you chose. A real statement paragraph belongs in a

or

at 24px or less.
